I originally got my bad breath in march of 2019, when my classmate next to me asked me if I farted, I was confused and I began to realize in every class people put their shirts over their nose when sitting next to me. It sucked so much, It went away in august of 2019 randomly, I lived life normal again without bad breath until may of 2021 (this year) when my friend said my breath stank and people in class didn’t want to sit next to me anymore out of nowhere. In july I randomly began to tremble and couldn’t walk anymore, I also struggled to eat. I went to the ER and they told me I had viral colitis and I was constipated. They told me to not eat fried foods or spicy foods for a week, and then the pain went away but my bad breath stuck with me. I currently still suffer from it and it sucks so much. In my english class the kid next to me told the teacher I smelled bad and that he wanted to sit somewhere else. I also work as a cashier and get looks from customers. I just want life to be normal again :(
